description: Proofpoint Targeted Attack Protection (TAP) Threat Insight API. Query SIEM click/message threat events, campaign intelligence, per-threat forensics, Very Attacked People and top clickers, threat summaries, and decode TAP-rewritten (urldefense) URLs. Authentication is HTTP Basic over TLS using a TAP service principal and secret created in the TAP Dashboard under Settings.

tools.name: campaign_get
tools.description: Get campaign detail (actors, malware, techniques, members). Required: campaignId. Returns the CampaignDetail.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: Campaign identifier from the TAP Dashboard or campaign ids endpoint

tools.name: campaign_list-ids
tools.description: Heavily rate limited (50 requests per rolling 24 hours). Prefer the local synced store for repeated queries. Required: interval. Optional: size (default: 100), page (default: 1). Returns array of CampaignSummary.

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum campaign IDs per page (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: forensics_get
tools.description: Provide exactly one of threatId or campaignId. threatId queries are limited to 50 per rolling 24 hours; campaignId queries to 1800. Optional: threatId, campaignId, includeCampaignForensics (default: false). Returns array of ForensicReport.

params.name: includeCampaignForensics
params.description: With threatId, also aggregate forensics for the associated campaign

tools.name: people_list-top-clickers
tools.description: List users who clicked the most malicious links in a window. Optional: window (default: 30), size (default: 100), page (default: 1). Returns array of ClickerUser.

tools.name: people_list-vap
tools.description: List Very Attacked People (highest attack index) for a window. Optional: window (default: 30), size (default: 1000), page (default: 1). Returns array of VapUser.

tools.name: siem_list-all-events
tools.description: Fetch all click and message threat events in the window. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: siem_list-clicks-blocked
tools.description: Fetch clicks to malicious URLs that were blocked in the window. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: siem_list-clicks-permitted
tools.description: Fetch clicks to malicious URLs that were permitted in the window. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: siem_list-issues
tools.description: Events for clicks to malicious URLs permitted and messages delivered containing a known threat within the window — the subset that got through and needs response. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: siem_list-messages-blocked
tools.description: Fetch blocked messages that contained a known threat. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: siem_list-messages-delivered
tools.description: Fetch delivered messages that contained a known threat. Optional: sinceSeconds (default: 3600), interval, sinceTime (plus 3 more). Returns the SiemResponse.

params.name: sinceSeconds
params.description: Seconds before now to start the window (max 3600 per request, lookback up to 7 days)

params.name: sinceTime
params.description: ISO8601 start time for the retrieval window

tools.name: threat_get-summary
tools.description: Get a threat summary (severity, spread, actors, malware, techniques). Required: threatId. Returns the ThreatSummary.

params.name: threatId
params.description: Threat identifier from SIEM events or the TAP Dashboard

tools.name: url_decode
tools.description: Decode TAP-rewritten (urldefense) URLs to their original targets. Required: urls. Returns array of UrlDecodeResult. (public)

params.name: urls
params.description: One or more TAP-rewritten (urldefense) URLs in v1, v2, or v3 format
